{{Quote|Face, mount up. Wraiths, prepare to execute the Loran Spit-ball.|Wedge Antilles|<ref name="Wraith">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref>}}
The '''Loran Spitball''' was a tactic developed by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit [[Wraith Squadron]] specifically for use while they were stationed aboard and operated from the modified [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] [[Ession Strike|''Night Caller'']].<ref name="Wraith" />

Developed by Wraith [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Garik Loran]]<ref name="Wraith" /> in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]'' to [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]].</ref> the tactic involved venting the atmosphere out of and opening the door for the corvette's bow hold, which had been modified to carry nine [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] instead of the four [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] that the warship had held while in service with [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]], itself a modification of the standard Corellian Corvette design. The fighters were then used as static torpedo launchers, allowing the corvette to unleash as many as eighteen [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] in a single attack.<ref name="Wraith" />

The tactic was used on two known occasions; first during the [[Battle of Talasea|battle]] of [[Talasea]], where the tactic was created, and again at the [[Battle of Ession|battle]] of [[Ession]].<ref name="Wraith" />
